replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: Thanks all . matic - the floor is flat for a reason, nothing worse than trying to fight and having to run all over blocks. The forest is dense and worrying about blocks being in the way is not a plus in my opinion. You will also notice that the leaves are never lower than 3 blocks in 99% of the map- this is because I want people to use the horses on the map and not worry with taking damage from blocks. I did place a few ground blocks for fun. :) also I could change the sand and add a design or something, but that really does not impact anything - and I wanted it to be very clear where the walls drop at, but thanks for the thoughts.
